verdict.rationale: Airwallex is a fintech API platform, so API versioning and a deprecation policy are a fair axis. The evidence pack documents APIs, SDKs, webhooks, a CLI and scoped keys, but nothing about API versioning or a deprecation policy. The server-side SDK being labeled beta is unrelated to API versioning policy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
